paper.title: ArtiCAD: Articulated CAD Assembly Design via Multi-Agent Code Generation
paper.central_claim: 训练无关多agent通过早期Connector计划、跨阶段回滚和自演化经验库生成更可靠的可编辑关节CAD，并持续改善未来任务。

provenance.notes: 派发配置sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol；当前无独立provider receipt/session标识，不探测模型。仅读固定全文及卡片，未读他席或历史判定；卡片历史结果不计分。

evidence.quote: Connectors serve as a cross-stage contract: the Design Agent specifies them at plan time, Generation Agents realize the corresponding frames on constructed solids, and the Assembly Agent aligns matched pairs through FreeCAD’s joint solver without any LLM call.
evidence.support_explanation: Typed connector handoff separates generation from deterministic assembly.

evidence.quote:
It partitions the existing parts into
keep
,
regenerate
, and
newly introduced
subsets. Faultless components are preserved in the “keep” pool, ensuring that only the affected nodes in the kinematic tree are re-planned or re-generated.
evidence.support_explanation: Localized repair preserves working parts within a task; not itself cross-task retention.

evidence.quote: It then distills the full generation trace—encompassing requirements, connector plans, code, and repair trajectories—into a structured case summary.
evidence.support_explanation: Persisted non-weight case artifact is grounded in complete traces.

evidence.quote:
Summaries are partitioned into
Good
or
Issue
cases in FAISS
evidence.support_explanation: Good/Issue partition and asymmetric retrieval; quality is judged, not counterfactual marginal utility.

evidence.quote:
Design Agents derive both
positive design heuristics
and
negative constraints
from the respective partitions, while Generation Agents strictly use
Good Cases
as clean
few-shot templates
evidence.support_explanation: Later design and generation read accumulated experience differently.

evidence.quote: this variant removes the experience store from retrieval augmentation process while keeping the documentation store, isolating the contribution of accumulated design knowledge gained from prior tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: Direct store-off comparison keeps documentation retrieval.
Store modestly improves geometry/motion and iterations, not detail or compilation success.

evidence.quote:
Reliability is robust: Krippendorff’s
α
\alpha
ranges from 0.58 to 0.64, and the 3-rater mean ICC
evidence.support_explanation: Judge agreement reported, but interjudge agreement is not ground-truth validation or run variance.
Failures explicitly included for geometric benchmark.

evidence.quote: First, the kinematic tree formulation cannot represent closed kinematic chains forming physical loops
This baseline uses the same generate-execute-repair loop (up to 5 retries) but has no design/code/assembly decomposition.
evidence.support_explanation: Shared retry cap, not matched total token/call/compute budget.

evidence.quote: To mitigate execution errors, several frameworks wrap LLMs in generate–execute–repair loops, utilizing sandbox traces
evidence.support_explanation: Author-positioned CADCodeVerify/Seek-CAD/EvoCAD/CADEvolve lineage; original neighbor full texts absent.

evidence.quote: This variant removes the VLM-based validation from both the Generation and Assembly Agents, along with the cross-stage rollback mechanism it triggers.
evidence.support_explanation: Rollback ablation removes validation as well: cannot isolate routing alone.

G.reason: 具体瓶颈是多部件连接关系的后置推断及拓扑命名不稳定；与单部件CAD和mesh关节重建有清楚区分。记忆本身与既有RAG/Reflexion的残余差异较弱，最近邻仅据本文而未核原文。

M.reason: Connector将LLM规划与精确对齐分工，错误分层及案例分区均能解释目标；条件独立和O(1)论证并不保证几何兼容，存储清洁度依赖自身judge。

X.reason: 计划校验、执行修复、设计/代码回滚、FAISS分区和后续读取均具体；缺案例准入阈值、去重/淘汰、版本/冲突和评测时初始化协议。

E.measurement.reason: 120项装配多judge评估、200项CADPrompt和354项ACD几何/关节指标及失败惩罚有可信度；judge一致性不等于人类/物理真值校验，开放设计质量仍有限。

E.causality.reason: 同backbone单模型基线、late-plan和store-off提供归因；经验仅小幅改变质量且detail逆向，rollback与视觉验证联合去除，额外多agent预算未隔离。

E.holdout.reason: 三基准支持任务能力，但经验库构建流、任务顺序、冻结与测试排除均未交代，不能以prior tasks措辞认定独立retained收益。

reason: 固定全文完整且主要方法与实验可判，独立留存和成本结论按证据范围收窄。
